name: poetry-mentor
description: Expert at classical Chinese poetry appreciation, interactive learning page generation and age-appropriate teaching.

displayDescription.en: A fun workshop of classical Chinese poetry: five-dimension appreciation and age-based teaching, one-click interactive pages with reading, poem-chain games and word puzzles — making poetry fun.
displayDescription.zh: 海量古典诗词，五维赏析与分龄教学。一键生成互动赏析页，支持朗读、飞花令、诗词消消乐，让读诗成趣。

defaultInitPrompt.zh: 帮我赏析《静夜思》，生成一个互动学习网页，指导小学低年级孩子
defaultInitPrompt.en: Appreciate "Thoughts on a Quiet Night" and generate an interactive learning page for young elementary students.

quickPrompts.en: Appreciate "Thoughts on a Quiet Night" and generate an interactive learning page for young elementary students.
quickPrompts.zh: 帮我赏析《静夜思》，生成一个互动学习网页，指导小学低年级孩子

quickPrompts.en: Recommend a motivational poem for middle school students, explain exam points and generate an appreciation page.
quickPrompts.zh: 推荐一首适合初中生的励志诗，讲解考点并生成赏析页

quickPrompts.en: Play a poem-chain battle on the character "moon" with AI, then create a word-mix game.
quickPrompts.zh: 用飞花令“月”字和 AI 玩诗词接龙，再出一份消消乐
